quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: Posters, signs, and stickers on the windshield and windows:

options.text: Are a fun way to personalize your vehicle.
Are permitted if they allow the driver some visibility.
Are not allowed unless the law requires them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are not allowed unless the law requires them.
questions.explanation: You cannot put signs, posters, or stickers on any window. The only exception is if the law requires it.

questions.question: As you approach the top of a hill, you should:

options.text: Speed up slightly.
Be ready to stop if needed.
Keep a steady speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: You cannot see what is on the other side of a hill. There could be a stopped car ahead. Slow down so you can stop if necessary.

questions.question: When exiting the interstate, you should start to slow down:

options.text: When you turn on your blinker to enter the deceleration lane.
When you see a sign for your exit.
After you turn into the deceleration lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you turn into the deceleration lane.
questions.explanation: Stay at highway speed while on the main road. Only slow down after you enter the deceleration lane.

questions.question: A broken yellow centerline means:

options.text: You cannot pass.
You can pass on the right when the road is clear.
You can pass on the left when the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line allows you to cross and pass another car on the left if no traffic is coming. Never cross a solid yellow line to pass.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop.
Merge.
Upcoming change in direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: When driving at night, you should:

options.text: Always use your high beams.
Look directly at oncoming headlights.
Stay farther back from the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther back from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: Night driving is more dangerous because you cannot see as well. Stay farther back from the car in front of you. This gives you more time to stop if they brake suddenly.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, return to your original lane when:

options.text: You can see both headlights of the other car in your rearview mirror.
You have passed the front bumper.
You are 50 feet ahead of the other car.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see both headlights of the other car in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Move back into your lane only when you can see both headlights of the passed car in your mirror. This means you have enough space to safely pull back in front.

questions.question: Looking far ahead while driving on the highway:

options.text: Helps you keep up with traffic.
Reduces sudden braking or turning.
Allows you to spot police ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduces sudden braking or turning.
questions.explanation: Watch the road far ahead. This helps you avoid last-minute braking or turning. You can drive safer, save fuel, and keep traffic moving smoothly.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No turns.
No outlet.
No U-turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turns.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You will see this sign where U-turns are unsafe.

questions.question: On a one-way street, you can only turn left onto another one-way street if:

options.text: You increase your speed before turning.
Traffic on that street moves to the right.
Traffic on that street moves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic on that street moves to the left.
questions.explanation: You can turn left onto a one-way street if traffic moves to the left. You cannot turn left onto a one-way street where traffic moves to the right.

questions.question: You drive defensively when you:

options.text: Keep one car length between you and the car ahead.
Look only at the car directly in front of you.
Keep scanning ahead for possible dangers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep scanning ahead for possible dangers.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means looking ahead for dangers. Staring only at the road right in front of you is unsafe. Scan ahead and stay alert to vehicles around you.

questions.question: Stopping distance and crash severity:

options.text: Get shorter as speed increases.
Are not affected by speed.
Get longer as speed increases.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get longer as speed increases.
questions.explanation: Higher speed causes serious problems. As speed increases, stopping distance gets longer and crashes become more severe, causing more injuries and deaths. Leave more space between cars when driving faster so you can stop safely if needed.

questions.question: You should always drive:

options.text: At the same speed as other vehicles around you.
At the speed limit.
At a safe speed for current road and weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: At a safe speed for current road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Your driving speed depends on road conditions, weather, and the speed limit. Never drive faster than the speed limit. Slow down when conditions are bad.

questions.question: Two traffic lanes go in your direction. You are in the left lane and cars are passing you on the right. A driver behind you wants to go faster. You should:

options.text: Stay in your lane to keep traffic moving.
Drive onto the left shoulder to let vehicles pass.
Move to the right lane when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right lane when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Use the left lane to drive fast, pass, or turn left. Use the right lane when driving slower than other traffic, entering the road, or turning right.

questions.question: Increase your following distance behind a large vehicle:

options.text: So you can see around the sides of the vehicle.
Because other drivers tend to pass large vehicles.
Because following too close causes wind problems.

questions.correctAnswerText: So you can see around the sides of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Truck, bus, and van drivers may not see you directly behind them. Leave more space behind large vehicles so you can see around them and see the road ahead.

questions.question: You want to park downhill on a road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the edge of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the edge of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill on a road with no curb, or uphill on a road with no curb, turn your wheels toward the road edge so your car rolls away from traffic if the brakes fail. When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn your wheels toward the center so the car rolls into the curb.

questions.question: In which situation should your wheels NOT be straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to turn left at a red light.
When parked on a hill or sloped driveway.
When parked on a level road with no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or sloped driveway.
questions.explanation: While waiting to turn left, keep your wheels straight. If hit from behind, this prevents you from sliding into oncoming traffic. When parked on a hill, turn your wheels so the car won't roll into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: A broken yellow centerline means:

options.text: You cannot pass.
You can pass on the right when the road is clear.
You can pass on the left when the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line on your side means you can cross the centerline to pass from your side of the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Do not drink and drive.
Slippery when wet.
Road curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate dangers. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: For a person 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:

options.text: 0.05 percent.
0.08 percent.
0.02 percent.

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: For drivers 21 and older, a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher is illegal. Driving under the influence of alcohol is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: You are driving at the speed limit and approach an intersection when the light turns yellow. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and continue through the intersection.
Speed up to cross before the light turns red.
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means the red light is coming soon. Stop at a yellow light if you can do so safely. If you cannot stop safely, proceed through the intersection with caution.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on interstate highways unless a different speed is posted?

options.text: 55 mph
65 mph
75 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 65 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit on interstate highways is 65 miles per hour. Always follow posted speed limits if they are different.

questions.question: You want to enter the freeway but there is no gap in traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed and force other drivers to make room.
Slow down on the ramp and wait for a gap.
Stop at the end of the ramp and wait for a gap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down on the ramp and wait for a gap.
questions.explanation: Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap in traffic. Do not stop at the end of the ramp because you will not have enough space to speed up to match traffic before entering the highway.

questions.question: When should you give up your right-of-way?

options.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
Never. It confuses other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Give up your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent collisions.

questions.question: Which factor affects how fast a person absorbs alcohol?

options.text: Weight
Height
Intelligence

questions.correctAnswerText: Weight
questions.explanation: A person's weight affects alcohol absorption. Other factors include biological sex, how much food is in the stomach, and how many drinks have been consumed. Time is the only way to remove alcohol from the body.

questions.question: When is a highway most slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining for several hours.
When it just starts to rain.
When it has been raining for one to two hours.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it just starts to rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery when rain first begins. Dirt and oil mix with the rainwater to create a slick surface.

questions.question: Your car can hydroplane when driving on wet roads. Hydroplaning can happen at speeds as low as:

options.text: 45 miles per hour
35 miles per hour
40 miles per hour

questions.correctAnswerText: 35 miles per hour
questions.explanation: At 35 mph, most tires can push water away. At speeds above 35 mph, tires cannot push water away as well. Your tires may lose contact with the road and slide on the water like water skis.

questions.question: What must you do when you see a flashing red light at an intersection?

options.text: Stop completely, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceed.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Stop and remain stopped until the light stops flashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceed.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Where is a U-turn not permitted?

options.text: In a parking lot
On or near curves or hills
On a straight road where you can see 500 feet ahead in both directions

questions.correctAnswerText: On or near curves or hills
questions.explanation: Never make a U-turn on or near curves or hills. You cannot see oncoming traffic or pedestrians and may cause a collision.

questions.question: Which road is most likely to be slippery in cold, wet weather?

options.text: A hilly, open road
A residential road
A road in a shaded area

questions.correctAnswerText: A road in a shaded area
questions.explanation: Shaded areas on roads freeze before other parts and thaw out later. In cold, wet weather, these shaded spots become icy first.

questions.question: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must:

options.text: Stop, no matter which direction you are driving.
Stop only if you are driving in the same direction.
Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, no matter which direction you are driving.
questions.explanation: You must stop completely before reaching a school bus that is picking up or dropping off children. This applies no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: Your license can be suspended if you are under 21 and drive with a blood alcohol level of:

options.text: 0.15 percent or higher.
0.08 percent or higher.
Any amount.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any amount.
questions.explanation: Drivers under 21 cannot have any alcohol in their system. Any trace of alcohol will result in serious penalties, including a two-year license suspension.

questions.question: What does a yellow left arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: Get ready to yield to oncoming traffic.
The protected left turn is about to end.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: A yellow left arrow means the protected left turn is ending. You must prepare to yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, the speed limit in an off-street parking facility is:

options.text: 15 mph.
25 mph.
35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: 15 mph.
questions.explanation: The speed limit in an off-street parking facility is 15 miles per hour. Follow any posted speed limit signs if they show a different speed.

questions.question: To yield to an emergency vehicle using its siren and flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Drive to the right edge of the road and stop.
Move to the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Stop immediately, even if you are in an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right edge of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: Move to the right edge of the road and stop to yield to an emergency vehicle. Do not stop in an intersection. You can drive again after the emergency vehicle passes.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Slow down and use your high beam headlights.
Flash your lights on and off to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and use low beam headlights. If you cannot see ahead, pull off the road and wait for the fog to clear.

questions.question: Alcohol is:

options.text: A stimulant.
An antihistamine.
A depressant.

questions.correctAnswerText: A depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows your thinking and makes your reflexes slower.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a single broken white line marking:

options.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: A dashed white line separates traffic moving in the same direction. You may cross it to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No right turn.
You must turn right.
Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you see heavy smoke ahead on the road, you should:

options.text: Turn on your four-way flashers and continue.
Slow down, move far to the right, and stop off the road.
Turn on your high beam headlights and continue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move far to the right, and stop off the road.
questions.explanation: When you see heavy smoke ahead, slow down immediately. Drive as far right as possible and stop off the road. Check if it is safe to continue before driving again. Some smoke can damage your eyes and lungs.
